title: Analytic centralisers of quadratic germs and the Brjuno dichotomy
summary: For $Q_α(z)=e^{2πiα}z+z^2$ with $α$ irrational, we prove that the analytic centraliser of $Q_α$ is trivial whenever $Q_α$ is not analytically linearizable. Together with the quadratic Brjuno--Yoccoz theorem this gives a complete dichotomy, for the centraliser is infinite cyclic at the non-Brjuno parameters and conjugate to the group of nonzero complex dilations at the Brjuno parameters. The result extends the dense-parameter conclusion of Avila--Cheraghi--Eliad to every nonlinearizable member of the quadratic family.
